summary: Mills Music Trust filed a routine Form 8-K reporting its quarterly distribution to Unit Holders. The Trust received a Q2 2026 contingent portion payment of roughly $684,729 ($2.4656 per Trust Unit) from Sony Music Publishing under the 1964 asset purchase agreement, versus $512,648 ($1.8460 per unit) a year earlier. After paying $111,347 to advisors, $573,382 ($2.0647 per unit) is distributed to holders of record as of September 22, 2026. No deal, vote, or board action is involved—this is an ordinary royalty pass-through update.
